[SWS_CanTSyn_00199]
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20073
⌈When Csm_MacVerify or Csm_SignatureVerify return a recoverable error code
(e.g., E_BUSY, QUEUE_FULL), then the Time Slave shall
• consider the verification of received FUP message as failed
• and increment the authentication build counter for this FUP message.
⌋
